chart.title: Interval metrics chart
chart.heatmap_desc: Shows interval distribution per data item. Darker cells mean larger gap metrics. Fixed mock data.
chart.heatmap_tip: Tip: tap an item group to switch ranges
chart.current_miss_desc: Current gap: periods since this item last appeared (e.g. 7 means absent for 7 periods).
chart.max_miss_desc: Max gap: the longest historical streak of absence for this item.
chart.avg_miss_desc: Average gap: mean periods between appearances.
chart.most_freq_miss_desc: Most common gap: the most frequent gap length between appearances.

advanced.tail_description: Shows how data items distribute by last digit (0–9). Fixed mock data.
advanced.group_description: Shows share by category groups (G01–G12), a generic mapping of former group labels. Fixed mock data.
advanced.odd_even_description: Shows the overall odd vs even share among data items. Fixed mock data.
advanced.consecutive_description: In the last {total} periods, adjacent items appeared {count} times ({ratio}%). The chart shows frequency per adjacent pair.
advanced.combination_description: Shows higher-frequency data-item combinations (fixed mock) for share demos.

how_ai_predict.question: How are recommendation sets generated?
how_ai_predict.answer: The demo builds sample sets from fixed mock frequency, interval, and range patterns to show the filter UI. It is not a real prediction model.

ai_accuracy.question: Can I use these results for decisions?
ai_accuracy.answer: No. All numbers and copy are for portfolio demonstration only and are not advice for financial or any other decision.

update_frequency.question: How often does the data update?
update_frequency.answer: Mock data is fixed and reproducible. Refresh example re-fetches the same demo payload so you can see the loading state.
